description:
[Results] Generate an interview result report (HTML/PDF/JSON) for a completed interview. The report is decision-support material for a human reviewer, not an automated hiring decision. A report in a language other than the result's is translated, at 0.1 credit per result. interview_result_id from list_interview_results: a single-stage row's `id`, a multi-stage row's `interview_result_id`.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

export_features_result.description: Which sections the report includes (contact details, AI assessment, transcript, scores...); its template is for a saved auto-export configuration (the top-level template wins). Left out: contact details, AI assessment, analytics, transcript and files are included; recordings, the rubric and the candidate packet are not.

export_type.description: Output format. Values: `pdf`: a signed URL to a PDF file | `html`: the report as an HTML string | `json`: the report data as structured JSON.

interview_result_id.description: The interview result to report on (a result id from list_interview_results).

interview_result_ids.description: Generate a single combined report for multiple results.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

store_file.description: When true (pdf only), persist the file to storage and return a signed URL.

allOf.description: Report layout. Omit to use the merchant's default from Branding & Configuration (modern when none is set).

template.description: Report layout: `classic`, `modern` or `one_pager`. Omit for the merchant default (modern when unset).

name: generate_interview_report
title: Generate interview report
